name: Minefield
design_intent: SPORTS hazard court (v8_sports_courts.md tier 3, hazard='bomb'). The center_pitch shell (2800x1600, strict mirror about x=1400 -- a known-fair symmetric base) with the two mid-caroms REMOVED and a SYMMETRIC FIELD of landmines/fuse bombs scattered across the midfield. Luck-and-chaos energy but STRICTLY fair (identical mines both halves). A mine detonation PUNTS the ball (Bomb._punt_balls -> Ball.receive_hazard_impulse, ~1500px/s point-blank, re-capped to 2400 chaseable) and INSTAKILLS a nearby player (the EXISTING kill(&ring_out) path; SPORTS respawns at 99 lives, never eliminates). Goals off a mine-punt = the laugh. SYMMETRY (SC-SYM/SYM-3): the central fuse bomb sits ON the centre axis (inherently symmetric); every other mine is a MIRROR PAIR at the same y with IDENTICAL params/phase, so no instant pressures one team's half more. SYM-4 (no own-goal machine): the outermost mine pair is at x900/x1900 (blast_radius 280 -> blasts reach at most x620/x2180), ~310px clear of the goal mouths (x170..310 / x2490..2630); no blast overlaps a goal mouth, so a punt sends the ball into OPEN play, never reliably into one net. TELEGRAPHY (§2.0#2): proximity landmines show a pulsing trigger ring while armed, then an accelerating blink + expanding warning ring to the exact lethal radius before blowing; the central fuse bomb counts a visible fuse and beats on a steady ~4s pulse (the guaranteed chaos heartbeat at dead centre, right where the kickoff ball rests). SC-CALM parity N/A (this is a chaos court). NO powerup_spawners. Spawns verbatim from center_pitch (x500/700 left, x2100/2300 right); nearest spawn x700 to nearest mine x900 keeps players clear of a live trigger ring (trigger_radius 180). Skilled power-shots still score (SC-CHAOS) -- chaos ADDS accidents, doesn't replace intent. FLIGHT GATE (from center_pitch): centre x=1400, nearest inner spawn x700 -> 700px (> 527 spring drift), centre-to-far-goal 1160px -> boost required.
